title: Barrot Revolution Hover Bike - Complete Assembly Guide

steps.title: Print and post-process frame sections
steps.description: Print all 4 frame sections using CF-PLA at 0.2mm layer height, 40% gyroid infill. Remove supports carefully with flush cutters. Sand joining surfaces to 400 grit.
safety: Wear gloves - CF-PLA splinters are sharp
tips: Print sections vertically for better layer adhesion on stress points

steps.title: Install titanium heat-set inserts
steps.description: Using soldering iron at 200°C, press M8 titanium inserts into all mounting holes. Inserts should be flush or 0.2mm below surface.
safety: Hot inserts can cause burns - use heat-resistant gloves
tips: Heat insert until just flush, then remove iron. Don't over-push.

steps.title: Join frame sections
steps.description: Align front and rear frame halves. Apply structural epoxy (JB Weld) to joint faces. Bolt together with M8×50mm titanium bolts, torque to 15 N·m.
safety: Allow epoxy to cure 24h before applying loads
tips: Check alignment with spirit level before epoxy sets

steps.title: Print and inspect magnet housings
steps.description: Print 4 magnet housings in PETG at 0.15mm, 80% infill. Verify all magnet pockets are within ±0.1mm tolerance using digital calipers.
safety: PETG can warp - use enclosed printer or draft shield
tips: Print orientation: pockets facing up to avoid support in critical areas

steps.title: Assemble Halbach arrays
steps.description: Insert N52 neodymium magnets into housings following Halbach configuration: rotate each magnet 90° clockwise from previous. Sequence: [N↑] [N→] [N↓] [N←] repeat. Lock with non-magnetic stainless screws.
safety: DANGER: Neodymium magnets can cause severe pinch injuries
Keep magnets away from electronics and credit cards
Never place two Halbach arrays face-to-face without fixtures
tips: Mark each magnet orientation before inserting
Use plastic tweezers near sensor boards

steps.title: Mount arrays to frame
steps.description: Bolt 4 magnet arrays to underside of frame at marked positions (FL, FR, RL, RR). Arrays should be co-planar within ±1mm. Shim if needed.
safety: Check array-to-ground clearance: minimum 5mm above ground surface
tips: Use feeler gauge to verify co-planarity before final tighten

steps.title: Install battery enclosure
steps.description: Mount 3D-printed battery enclosure to frame centre (lowest point for CoG). Install rubber vibration isolators at 4 mounting points.
tools: drill for pilot holes if needed
safety: Ensure enclosure drains are pointed down (if included)
tips: Low CoG improves stability - keep battery as low as possible

steps.title: Wire power system
steps.description: Install battery → BMS → main bus bar wiring. Use 10AWG silicone wire for main power runs. All positive wires: red. All ground: black. Install 40A main fuse within 15cm of battery positive terminal.
safety: CRITICAL: Verify polarity before connecting battery
Install fuse BEFORE any other connections
LiPo batteries can cause fire if shorted
tips: Pre-tin all wire ends before crimping
Use heat shrink on all exposed connections

steps.title: Install solar panel and DC-DC converter
steps.description: Mount thin-film solar panel to top of frame. Connect to 48V charge controller input. Install DC-DC 48V→12V converter for electronics power rail.
safety: Verify solar polarity before connecting to charge controller
tips: Route solar cables away from moving parts

steps.title: Install supercapacitor bank
steps.description: Mount supercapacitor bank near motor controllers (minimise wire length). Connect in parallel with main battery bus via balancing circuit.
safety: Supercapacitors hold charge - discharge before working on circuit
tips: Keep supercap wires <30cm for minimum inductance

steps.title: Install hub motors
steps.description: Press hub motors into 3D-printed wheel hub adapters. Bolt adapter to wheel with M6×20 bolts at 6-point pattern. Torque to 10 N·m. Check for <0.3mm runout.
safety: Support motor weight during installation - don't stress cable exit
tips: Apply Loctite 243 to hub adapter bolts

steps.title: Wire motor controllers (ESC)
steps.description: Connect each motor phase to ESC (any order - adjust in firmware). Connect ESC power to main bus. Connect ESC signal to Raspberry Pi GPIO.
safety: Phase current can exceed 60A at peak - verify all connections are crimped
tips: Test each ESC in isolation before connecting both

steps.title: Mount Raspberry Pi and sensors
steps.description: Install Raspberry Pi in control pod with standoffs. Mount IMU (MPU-6050) at Centre of Gravity of frame. Mount 4 ultrasonic sensors at corners (pointing down). Mount Hall effect sensors adjacent to each magnet array.
safety: IMU must be rigidly mounted - vibration will corrupt readings
Keep IMU away from magnets (>100mm)
tips: Level the RPi board before securing to ensure IMU alignment

steps.title: Flash and configure firmware
steps.description: Install Raspberry Pi OS Lite. Copy control_firmware.py to /home/pi/. Install dependencies: pip install RPi.GPIO smbus. Configure I2C in raspi-config. Flash Arduino coprocessor with sensor_fusion.ino.
safety: Test firmware on bench BEFORE mounting on vehicle
tips: Enable I2C and SPI in raspi-config before trying sensor libraries

steps.title: Calibrate sensors
steps.description: Run IMU calibration: place bike on flat surface, run calibration script 60s. Zero ultrasonic sensors at known height (use 15mm block). Calibrate Hall sensors with no-load (record zero-current offset).
safety: Calibrate with NO magnets energised for Hall sensor zero
tips: Save calibration values to /etc/barrot/calibration.json

steps.title: Static levitation test
steps.description: With bike unloaded (no rider), power on control system. Enable levitation at low power. Verify stable hover at 10-20mm. Check all 4 corner heights are equal (±2mm).
safety: Keep hands clear of magnet arrays during first power-on
Have emergency stop ready (main fuse pull)
tips: Start at 20% coil power, increase gradually

steps.title: Load testing (incremental)
steps.description: Add weight in 10kg increments (use sandbags). Verify system holds height and remains stable at each increment. Record current draw and height at each load step.
safety: Do not exceed 90kg during initial testing
Stop test if height drops below 8mm
tips: Log all data - useful for PID tuning

steps.title: Dynamic stability and propulsion test
steps.description: With rider at low speed (5 km/h), verify attitude control maintains stability. Gradually increase to 20 km/h. Check for oscillations or twitchiness.
safety: WEAR FULL PROTECTIVE GEAR for first ride test
Have a safety observer present
Test near walls/barriers for safety
Emergency: lean forward to stop → regenerative braking engages
tips: Small test area first - avoid open roads until fully validated

tools.note: Enclosed for ABS/Nylon; hardened nozzle for CF-PLA
Critical for magnet housing tolerance check
For heat inserts and wire work

troubleshooting.cause: PID gains too aggressive (Kp too high)
troubleshooting.solution: Reduce Kp by 20%. Increase Kd slightly. Check IMU is rigidly mounted.

troubleshooting.symptom: System fails to lift at target height
troubleshooting.cause: Halbach arrays not co-planar OR magnet orientation wrong
troubleshooting.solution: Re-verify array mounting with straight edge. Check Halbach sequence: each magnet 90° from previous.

troubleshooting.cause: ESC current limit too high OR poor motor cooling
troubleshooting.solution: Reduce ESC current limit by 10A. Verify motor can spin freely (no mechanical friction).

troubleshooting.cause: Levitation taking excessive power OR battery health degraded
troubleshooting.solution: Log coil currents - if >60% continuously, re-tune height PID. Check battery voltage under load.

troubleshooting.symptom: IMU drift causing tilt over time
troubleshooting.cause: Gyroscope drift (normal) - alpha value too high
troubleshooting.solution: Reduce complementary filter alpha from 0.98 to 0.95. Recalibrate IMU on level surface.

troubleshooting.cause: Sensor too close to permanent magnets
troubleshooting.solution: Move Hall sensors to side of Halbach array, not underneath. Minimum 15mm from magnet face.

safety_procedures: MAGNETS: Always handle N52 neodymium magnets with gloves. Keep >300mm from pacemakers.
BATTERY: Never short LiPo terminals. Store at 50% SOC if unused >1 week.
ELECTRICAL: Always disconnect battery before working on circuits.
FIRMWARE: Test all code on bench before installing in vehicle.
RIDING: Wear helmet and full protective gear at all times.
SPEED: Do not exceed 20 km/h until >5 hours of ride time logged.
SURFACE: Only operate on smooth flat surfaces (concrete/asphalt).
OBSERVER: Never ride without a safety observer present.
EMERGENCY: Emergency stop = cut main fuse. Location: battery enclosure left side.
FIRE: Keep Class D / CO2 extinguisher nearby during first power tests.
